terms.seoDescription: Read the Ikigembe terms and conditions for viewers and producers.
terms.title: Terms & Conditions

s1.title: Acceptance of Terms
s1.body: By accessing or using the Ikigembe platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

s2.title: Platform Description
s2.body: Ikigembe is a video streaming platform that connects content producers with viewers. We provide a marketplace for Rwandan and African film content, enabling producers to distribute their work and viewers to discover and purchase content.

s3.title: User Accounts
s3.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account. You may not share your account with others or use another user's account.

s4.title: Producer Responsibilities
s4.body: Producers uploading content to Ikigembe confirm that they hold all necessary rights to the content. Content must not infringe on any third-party intellectual property, contain illegal material, or violate any applicable laws. Ikigembe reserves the right to remove content that violates these terms.

s5.title: Revenue & Payments
s5.body: Producers earn a share of revenue from content purchases. Ikigembe retains a platform fee from each transaction. Withdrawal requests are processed within 3–5 business days. Minimum withdrawal amount is RWF 5,000.

s6.title: Content Purchases
s6.body: All purchases on Ikigembe are final. Content is made available for streaming upon successful payment. Ikigembe does not offer refunds except in cases of technical failure or fraudulent charges.

s7.title: Intellectual Property
s7.body: All content on the Ikigembe platform remains the intellectual property of the respective producers. The Ikigembe brand, logo, and platform design are the property of Ikigembe. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without explicit written permission.

s8.title: Privacy
s8.body: Your use of Ikigembe is also governed by our Privacy Policy. We collect and use your personal information solely to provide and improve our services. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

s9.title: Prohibited Conduct
s9.body: You agree not to: attempt to bypass payment systems, reverse-engineer the platform, upload malicious content, harass other users, or use the platform for any unlawful purpose.

s10.title: Termination
s10.body: Ikigembe reserves the right to suspend or terminate any account that violates these Terms and Conditions, with or without prior notice.

s11.title: Changes to Terms
s11.body: We may update these Terms and Conditions from time to time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

s12.title: Contact
s12.bodyBeforeEmail: For questions about these Terms and Conditions, please contact us at
